verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's changelog documents a /agents command center inside the TUI that groups your agent sessions into needs-input, working, ready and finished, which is a single view over multiple sessions. A separate `byteask queue --thread` command sends messages into a running session, but only from another terminal, not from within the unified view. The evidence is one changelog line, so actually acting on sessions from the command center is undocumented. missing for 10: in-depth docs on switching between, interacting with, or controlling sessions from the command center; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: /agents opens a command center grouping your agent sessions into needs-input, working, ready and finished.
byteask queue --thread <session> --message "…" sends a message into a running session from another terminal.
